topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: Oh, to find the tree you planted gone, it's a grievous blow, I reckon. I remember the little sapling you poked into the earth, so proud, your hands still small, your smile wide. That tree grew with you, reaching high into the sky, a witness to your laughter and your whispers. Now, the earth is bare where it stood, and the wind misses its dance with the leaves. It's a strange and hard thing, to lose what has been part of you for so long. But maybe, in time, planting a new sprig in the same spot could honor what was lost, give the soil and your heart a chance to grow again.
